title: Jude and the Winter
author: S. M. Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Thornbury, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
